oil.when: 2013–2015 (SET/CLR button on the driver information display)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on and bring Remaining Oil Life up on the driver information display.
Press and hold SET/CLR for more than five seconds, until the reading changes to 100%.
oil.note: Checked in the 2013 and 2015 owner's manuals.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label on the driver's door pillar.
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressure is corrected, then goes off on its own after a short drive.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2013 and 2015 owner's manuals. If the light comes on only on cold mornings and goes off as you drive, a tire is getting low. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.
